images.alt: Satellite picture of Aotearoa New Zealand showing front cloud over central parts of the country. High cloud in the north.

post.text:
Here's the near noon picture from the Himawari-8 Japanese Satellite in space. 🇯🇵🛰️

The frontal shower band is creeping up through Wairarapa. 🌦️

Pockets of fog visible over inland lower South Island.

A fan of high cloud up north. 

All your weather intel here
MetService - Te Ratonga Tirorangi
